Card Q&A.q: If a Digimon card with DigiXros requirements is played by an effect and this card is placed in the digivolution cards by a DigiXros, does this card's inherited effect activate when a Digimon card with this card in its digivolution cards is played by an effect?

Effect: [When Attacking] By deleting 1 of your other Digimon, delete 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with a level less than or equal to the deleted Digimon's level.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When you play a Digimon by an effect, gain 1 memory.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] 0 from Lv.2 w/[Xros Heart] in traits
